decisive_items: A working diagnosis of probable RICH was made
it was a single, nonpulsatile, well-demarcated, dark brown atrophic plaque with a linear midline depression and an elevated, compressible, soft border
AccuVein AV400 infrared vein finder was used; it revealed one large vein with an extensive network of small superficial branching vessels localized to the area of the atrophic plaque
response.rationale: The vignette explicitly concludes with a working diagnosis of probable RICH, and the clinical and vascular findings support a congenital hemangioma rather than smooth muscle hamartoma or lipoatrophy.
